method: Frozen source contract review, producer tracing and isolated exact-helper execution; no production population or full application runtime test.

assessments.assessment: These are four different policy sets: seeded vocabulary, agent write authorization, contradiction precedence, and provenance promotion. Adding a state does not necessarily require adding it to all four. The proposed vocabulary-minus-todo/merging/cancelled derivation includes canceled, which the current positive allowlist rejects. It would also authorize future vocabulary additions by default.
assessments.recommendation: Retain an explicit positive agent authorization policy. A shared provider-neutral lifecycle owner may expose separately named policies or explicit role metadata; do not derive write authority by subtracting a few disallowed states or make provider-neutral tools depend on a GitHub seeding adapter.

assessments.assessment: GitHub ingestion trims/lowercases configured prefixes and label names, removes marker suffixes, deduplicates and sorts state labels. Closed issues return Closed; nonempty contradictory labels resolve deterministically. The resolver favors todo, then ranked dispositions, then unknown labels, then ci-wait; equal ranks preserve incoming order, which ingestion has already sorted. IssueSync already shares the resolver normalizer, but can promote one fresh nonterminal disposition beside a prior daemon claim. Removing this provenance path changes repair behavior.
assessments.recommendation: Preserve source label evidence and provenance separately from the resolved state; make prefix decoding an adapter responsibility and lifecycle precedence a domain responsibility.

assessments.assessment: DispatchPolicy strips lowercase agent: before lowercasing, whereas TicketState lowercases first and trims again after stripping. Thus uppercase AGENT:REWORK differs at these helper boundaries. TurnPrompt lowercases without trimming. TurnLoop uses trim/lowercase on bare issue state and configured active states; DispatchPolicy accepts a prebuilt MapSet and handles nonbinary normalization with an empty string. Canonical GitHub ingestion already removes configured prefixes, so helper differences alone do not demonstrate an ingestion failure.
assessments.recommendation: Define bare-state versus external-label inputs explicitly before extraction; preserve validation/error envelopes and active-state collection handling.

assessments.contract: UI work state versus tracker state
assessments.assessment: Summaries filters three hardcoded agent: terminal tags; predicates and marker sets accept atom/string work states, but sort buckets accept atoms only. Producer tracing and an exact-helper probe establish that State.issue_tag itself ignores custom prefixes and may select a marker first; see producer_trace. Tracker dispositions and live agent work states are distinct concepts. Production terminal candidate retention and string work-state arrival remain unproved.
assessments.recommendation: Keep a typed UI summary boundary separate from tracker label decoding. Trace summary producers before claiming a production prefix/sort incident; normalize only a bounded known vocabulary, never arbitrary string-to-atom conversion.

assessments.assessment: CILifecycle comments still describe contradictory-label ingestion as state:nil, while Issues now resolves nonempty label sets. CILifecycle prioritizes a binary state and falls back to resolving state_labels. This is stale source documentation, not evidence that current contradictory-label ingestion yields nil or that the guard is omitted in that path.

limits: One concept family assessed. Not the completed concept or constant sweep. Isolated helper probes do not establish full runtime correctness, prevalence, savings, complete producer tracing, or full finding verification.

path: AgentEvents.agent_summary/4 -> removes nil extras, preserves other values
producer_trace.assessment: The prefix assumption begins in State.issue_tag, not only the terminal filter: custom-prefix-only labels produce nil, then AgentEvents drops the tag key. It also selects markers by input order. Changing the filter to configured terminal tags alone cannot repair missing or marker-valued tags. Prefer carrying canonical issue state separately from display labels; retain pause/park/watch override semantics. Polled summaries use the fresh candidate snapshot, so this trace does not prove terminal tickets remain in production candidate sets. Running entries can supplement absent poll entries; real incidence still requires a population trace.
producer_trace.work_state: Idle summaries produce atom :paused/:idle. Running summaries forward control.status or atom :working. Sampled update sites use atoms; no string-producing runtime path established. String predicate/sort disagreement remains a reproducible permissive-input contract difference, not a proven production sorting incident.
